caption_L1: Here a bar graph is labeled Gross domestic product of Nunavut , Canada in 2019 , by industry (in million chained 2012 Canadian dollars). The x-axis measures industry classification using categorical scale from Accommodation and food services to Wholesale trade while the y-axis shows GDP in million chained 2012 Canadian dollars on linear scale from 0 to 800.
caption_L2L3: Mining, quarrying and oil is a major industry in this area. Construction was 2nd highest in 2019. Farming and the arts brought in little or no income to the area that year.
